task.summary: Speed up Node.MarshalJSON for raw AST nodes by returning the already-stored raw JSON directly instead of re-encoding it, without changing the produced output.
task.instructions: Optimize the ast package for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark BenchmarkEncodeRaw_Sonic measures it; existing tests must still pass.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: Node.MarshalJSON re-encodes raw AST nodes through the general encoder buffer instead of returning the raw JSON already held by the node.

ops_fault.description: Marshalling raw ast.Node values goes through the full encoder buffer path in ast/encode.go even when the node already holds its raw JSON bytes.
detection_keywords: encoder buffer used for already-raw JSON
no fast path for raw ast nodes
repair_keywords: return raw string directly on isRaw

visible_context.issue_text: Marshalling raw ast.Node values to JSON is slower than necessary because the node is re-encoded through the general encoder buffer even when it already holds the raw JSON bytes.
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization PR #845; adds a raw-node fast path in Node.MarshalJSON and swaps make for dirtmake.Bytes.
